## NEW this scan (vs. 2026-04-06 cache) — first-class agent + governance surfaces:
- **Agents API** (v1beta1): projects.locations.agents with create/list/get/patch/delete — first-class agent resource beyond generic model endpoints. [SIGNIFICANT]
- **Agent Studio** — visual agent builder (docs component).
- **Semantic Governance Policies + Policy Engines** — AI safety/compliance policy resources. [SIGNIFICANT]
- **Reasoning Engines** now expose query, asyncQuery, streamQuery + Sessions (stateful interactions) + runtime revisions.

- Deployment Resource Pools; Persistent Resources; Schedules; Specialist Pools; Studies & Trials; Tensorboards.
- Notebook Execution & Runtime Management; Model Deployment Monitoring; Model Evaluations.
- Long-running operations; media upload; prompt augmentation & corroboration; instance evaluation.
